rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent profiled compact mass across all four views, so it clears the coherence gate and does not show visible collisions between solids. The main weakness is that the street edge is only lightly acknowledged; the blue frontage is adjacent but the mass does not carve a convincing public threshold or void. The parcel relationship is acceptable because the form sits within the green boundary without simply becoming a box-filling extrusion, and the silhouette is resolved as a single tapered/stepped body rather than repetitive code steps. Programmatically it can plausibly support neighborhood living or mixed neighborhood use, but it is still closer to a generic compact object than to an explicitly active street building with a clear ground-public sequence. Because the brief is compact neighborhood living rather than a hall or tower, the mass can pass program fit, but only marginally and with a recommendation to strengthen the ground void/entry condition.
